# PhoneFarm Fun (phonefarm.fun)

> Factory-built Android device farm hardware from Guangzhou, China — real-device labs for mobile QA, app testing, automation, and B2B deployment. **Primary language: English (en-US).**

## Language
- Primary: English (en-US) — all public pages, product copy, FAQ, and checkout
- Sales support: English via Telegram, WhatsApp, and email

## About
PhoneFarm Fun is a Guangzhou-based hardware manufacturer (since 2017) supplying real Android device farm boxes, motherboard clusters, multi-device lab racks, lab accessories, and custom rack solutions. We assemble chassis locally, run burn-in QC, and export worldwide. We supply hardware only — vendor-neutral ADB tooling; no proprietary software lock-in.

## Product categories
- Phone Farm Box (20-node Samsung / Snapdragon / Exynos configurations)
- Motherboard Box (headless Android clusters)
- Android Phone Farm starter SKU
- iPhone / multi-device lab rack (customer devices)
- Turnkey real-device lab bundle
- Empty chassis expansion
- USB hub, PSU, cooling, network accessories
- Custom 40+ node rack solutions
